Latin word

per

per (+ accusative)

preposition with the accusative

through; throughout, all over; all through (a time); via, by way of, through

    the recommended word · classical · Catull. 101.1: multās per gentēs et multa per aequora vectus; Cato Agr. 37: per hiemem lūcubrātiōne haec facitō

  • via

    the recommended word · classical · Vulg. Mt. 2.12: per aliam viam reversī sunt; Caes. BG 1.6.1: ūnum per Sēquanōs
